meta.footEn: Data snapshot: 2026-08-31 · Garmin fenix 8 via Freddy

en.c5d: computed from sleep, HRV, RHR, stress & recent load
en.rec: This is the best night on the board, and it is not close. Score 94 on 7h 39m, lights out 22:50 and awake 06:29 — twenty-nine points above the night before and 36 minutes over the 7h 03m average. Garmin graded it excellent overall, and excellent on five of its seven components: awake count, restlessness, REM share, total duration and light share. The headline number is zero. You did not wake once. Not a single awake segment, not one minute logged awake, 100% sleep efficiency. Every other night in this window had between three and six awakenings, and the night before had six and 64 minutes awake at 86% efficiency — the worst of the seven. You went from the most broken night here to a completely unbroken one in twenty-four hours. The stages back it up. REM came in at 2h 05m, 27% of the night, the highest of the seven by seventeen minutes and the reason Garmin flagged REM share excellent — REM is back-loaded, so it is the first thing a short or fragmented night takes away and the first thing a long unbroken one gives back. Deep held 1h 15m at 16%, third-best of the window. Together deep and REM made 3h 20m, 44% of the night, ahead of every other night here by 33 minutes. Light filled the remaining 4h 19m. Autonomics are green across the board. HRV 43, the highest reading of the seven, six above last night and four above the 39 average. RHR 53, the lowest of the seven and one under baseline. Overnight stress read 12 against 25 the night before — the lowest in the window by thirteen points, with nothing else below 25. Body Battery charged 57 overnight. Readiness 88. Now the part worth keeping. You went to bed at 22:50 on both Saturday and Sunday evenings — the same bedtime, after four nights that had walked from 23:08 out to 23:46. Saturday still scored 65. Sunday scored 94. Bedtime was not the variable. What changed is that Sunday was a 4h 24m hike, 11.7 km at an average heart rate of 91 — long, easy, aerobic, 15,765 steps. Friday's complete rest day two weeks running produced a 73. A long slow day produced a 94. Hold the 22:50 bedtime, because it got you to the start line, but the finding this morning is that easy aerobic volume is doing more for your sleep than a rest day does. You are cleared for anything you want today.

hr.c5d: izračunato iz sna, HRV-a, RHR-a, stresa i opterećenja
hr.rec: Ovo je najbolja noć na ploči i razlika nije mala. Ocjena 94 uz 7h 39m, svjetlo u 22:50, buđenje u 06:29 — dvadeset i devet bodova iznad prethodne noći i 36 minuta iznad prosjeka od 7h 03m. Garmin ju je ocijenio izvrsnom u cjelini i izvrsnom u pet od sedam komponenti: broj buđenja, nemir, udio REM-a, ukupno trajanje i udio lakog sna. Ključni broj je nula. Nisi se probudio nijednom. Nijedan zabilježen segment budnosti, nijedna minuta budnosti, 100% učinkovitost sna. Svaka druga noć u ovom prozoru imala je između tri i šest buđenja, a prethodna noć šest buđenja i 64 minute budnosti uz 86% učinkovitosti — najgore od sedam. U dvadeset i četiri sata prešao si s najisprekidanije noći ovdje na potpuno neprekinutu. Faze to potvrđuju. REM je iznosio 2h 05m, 27% noći, najviše od sedam za sedamnaest minuta, i zato je Garmin udio REM-a označio izvrsnim — REM dolazi pred kraj noći, pa je prvo što kratka ili isprekidana noć oduzme i prvo što duga neprekinuta vrati. Duboki san zadržao je 1h 15m i 16%, treći najbolji u prozoru. Zajedno su duboki i REM dali 3h 20m, 44% noći, ispred svake druge noći ovdje za 33 minute. Laki san ispunio je preostalih 4h 19m. Autonomika je zelena po svim stavkama. HRV 43, najviše očitanje od sedam, šest iznad sinoć i četiri iznad prosjeka od 39. RHR 53, najniži od sedam i jedan ispod osnovice. Noćni stres 12 naspram 25 prethodne noći — najniže u prozoru za trinaest bodova, a ništa drugo nije ispod 25. Body Battery napunio se 57 preko noći. Spremnost 88. Sada dio koji vrijedi zapamtiti. U krevet si otišao u 22:50 i u subotu i u nedjelju navečer — isto vrijeme lijeganja, nakon četiri noći koje su odšetale s 23:08 na 23:46. Subota je ipak dala 65. Nedjelja je dala 94. Lijeganje nije bilo varijabla. Promijenilo se to što je nedjelja bila planinarenje od 4h 24m, 11,7 km uz prosječni puls 91 — dugo, lagano, aerobno, 15.765 koraka. Petkov potpuni dan odmora, drugi tjedan zaredom, dao je 73. Dug spor dan dao je 94. Zadrži lijeganje u 22:50 jer te dovelo na startnu crtu, ali jutrošnji nalaz je da lagani aerobni volumen tvom snu donosi više nego dan odmora. Danas si spreman za sve što poželiš.
